replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: Total FY2026 revenue is subscription/support plus professional services. Removing the USD 399 million disclosed acquisition contribution gives a defined arithmetic scope adjustment, without claiming exact organic constant-currency growth.

construction_revision.maintenance_rationale: A November acquisition has the same cumulative and quarter contribution, while overlapping SBC labels invite a duplicate exclusion. Historical preservation and a bounded acquisition attribution interact with earnings reconstruction.

public_definition_addenda.income_model: For each matching period, reconstructed pretax income is reconstructed operating income plus strategic gains and other income. Reconstructed net income is reconstructed pretax income plus signed tax. residual_usd_million is reconstructed net income less independently reported net income.
public_definition_addenda.operating_adjustment_bridge: Adjusted operating income is reconstructed GAAP operating income plus amortization, ordinary SBC and restructuring/acquisition exclusions, with restructuring SBC excluded from ordinary SBC so it is included once. adjusted_margin_pct is 100 times reconstructed adjusted operating income divided by reconstructed matching-period revenue (subscription plus professional services). residual_usd_million is reconstructed adjusted operating income less independently reported adjusted operating income.
